parts.name: Front Wheel
parts.description: A 16-inch cast-aluminum front wheel with a 130/90-16 Dunlop tire, the brake disc and the axle.
parts.function: Carries the front of the bike, provides steering grip and holds the front brake disc.

parts.name: Front Wheel (Cast Rim)
parts.description: A 16-inch cast-aluminum wheel. The diameter matches Honda's published size; the spoke design shown is representative.
parts.function: Holds the tire's bead and connects the tire to the hub, bearings and brake disc.

parts.name: Front Tire 130/90-16
parts.description: A Dunlop 130/90-16 tire. Its outside diameter in the 3D view is calculated from the tire size.
parts.function: The front contact patch provides steering and braking grip. Most braking force goes through the front tire.
parts.verificationNote: Tire size and brand are from Honda's 2026 information. Inflation pressures are not yet verified here; see the owner's manual or tire placard.

parts.name: Front Axle
parts.description: The axle shaft that runs through the front wheel hub and both fork sliders.
parts.function: Locates the wheel between the fork legs and acts as the shaft the wheel bearings turn on.
parts.verificationNote: The part number and torque spec are not yet verified for 2026 CMX500A.

service.notes: Torque specification not yet verified. Consult the Honda service manual (61MLH00).

parts.name: Front Wheel Bearings
parts.description: Sealed ball bearings in the wheel hub.
parts.function: Let the wheel spin freely on the axle.
